nodes.notes: The host is swapped, not the path: $execution.resumeUrl is built from WEBHOOK_URL and would say localhost:5678, which inside media-service means media-service. The split keeps the execution id and any ?signature= the resume URL carries.

nodes.name: Wait for ingest
nodes.notes: httpMethod is POST on purpose. The default is GET, and a POST callback to a GET-only resume webhook 404s — the execution then waits forever for a callback that already happened.

nodes.name: Ingested
nodes.notes: F4 continues from here: the transcript service takes video_id, never the URL.

nodes.name: Ingest failed
nodes.notes: Reached because the service calls back on failure too. Without that this branch is unreachable and the execution simply never ends. F9 hangs the Telegram alert here.

nodes.notes: Reached because the service calls back on failure too. Without that this branch is unreachable and the execution simply never ends. F9 hangs the Telegram alert here.

nodes.name: Transcribe
nodes.notes: Synchronous, unlike ingest: transcription runs at roughly 0.05x realtime on the GPU, so an 11-minute source takes ~30 s. The 15-minute timeout below is what covers a long source; if one ever hits it, this node becomes a job + Wait pair like ingest.

nodes.name: Chunk
nodes.notes: Takes a video_id, not segments. The service reads transcript.json off the shared volume, so thousands of segments never travel through n8n. Add max_chunk_s / min_chunk_s here to tune the thresholds without a rebuild.

nodes.name: Chunked
nodes.notes: The chunk rows are the deliverable; this is just the summary the execution shows. F5 inserts Translate between Transcribe and Chunk.

nodes.name: Start ingest
nodes.notes: The host is swapped, not the path: $execution.resumeUrl is built from WEBHOOK_URL and would say localhost:5678, which inside media-service means media-service. The split keeps the execution id and any ?signature= the resume URL carries.

nodes.name: Wait for ingest
nodes.notes: httpMethod is POST on purpose. The default is GET, and a POST callback to a GET-only resume webhook 404s — the execution then waits forever for a callback that already happened.

nodes.name: Ingested
nodes.notes: F4 continues from here: the transcript service takes video_id, never the URL.

nodes.name: Ingest failed
nodes.notes: Reached because the service calls back on failure too. Without that this branch is unreachable and the execution simply never ends. F9 hangs the Telegram alert here.

nodes.name: Transcribe
nodes.notes: Synchronous, unlike ingest: transcription runs at roughly 0.05x realtime on the GPU, so an 11-minute source takes ~30 s. The 15-minute timeout below is what covers a long source; if one ever hits it, this node becomes a job + Wait pair like ingest.

nodes.name: Chunk
nodes.notes: Takes a video_id, not segments. The service reads transcript.json off the shared volume, so thousands of segments never travel through n8n. Add max_chunk_s / min_chunk_s here to tune the thresholds without a rebuild.

nodes.name: Chunked
nodes.notes: The chunk rows are the deliverable; this is just the summary the execution shows. F5 inserts Translate between Transcribe and Chunk.

nodes.name: Start metadata
nodes.notes: Starts one idempotent metadata job. A repeated active request reuses its job instead of spending twice.

nodes.name: Wait for metadata
nodes.notes: The metadata service posts the terminal job state here. POST must match the callback method.

nodes.name: Metadata valid?
nodes.notes: Voice and render stay blocked unless the job completed and every required metadata item is selected.

nodes.name: Metadata selected
nodes.notes: Carries the immutable metadata revision and soft cost warning evidence into the media stages.

nodes.name: Metadata failed
nodes.notes: Terminal metadata failure is needs_action. Selected peer results remain reusable on retry.

parameters.text:
={{ 'Metadata cần xử lý cho video ' + $json.video_id + '.
Mã lỗi: ' + $json.error_code + '
Chi tiết: ' + $json.error + '
Hãy dùng Retry metadata stage; các kết quả đã thành công được giữ lại.' }}

nodes.name: Metadata needs action
nodes.notes: Sent only after bounded service retries are exhausted or operator input is required.

nodes.name: Vietnamese?
nodes.notes: Acceptance 9: a Vietnamese source makes no call to the translate service at all. Whisper's detected language is the only input to this decision, which is why /transcribe returns it.

nodes.name: Start translate
nodes.notes: Async like ingest, and for the same reason: 104 segments through a 1.8B model on CPU is minutes, and n8n's HTTP node gives up at 300 s. The host in the callback is swapped, not the path — see Start ingest.

nodes.name: Wait for translation
nodes.notes: httpMethod is POST on purpose. The default is GET, and a POST callback to a GET-only resume webhook 404s.

nodes.name: Translate failed
nodes.notes: A misalignment lands here, not in the chunks table. A segment list that came back one short would shift every subtitle after it, and that is only visible three stages later.

nodes.name: Start voice
nodes.notes: Async, and the longest job in the pipeline: synthesis runs slower than real time on CPU, so an 11-minute video is roughly 35 minutes here. The voice is the service's configured default; add a `voice` field to override it from one of the eight ZeroTTS ships.

nodes.name: Wait for voice
nodes.notes: httpMethod is POST on purpose. The default is GET, and a POST callback to a GET-only resume webhook 404s.

nodes.name: Voice ok?
nodes.notes: The failure branch matters as much as the success one: a voice job that dies without calling back parks this execution forever.

nodes.name: Voiced
nodes.notes: `warnings` is carried forward deliberately. A segment that needed more than 1.35x to fit its slot is shipped, not clamped — clamping would keep it listenable and put it out of sync — so the only defence is that somebody is told.

nodes.name: Start render
nodes.notes: Builds one immutable media revision from the selected metadata revision. The render service owns validation, clean-master reuse, mock-brand derivation, and failed-asset resume.

nodes.name: Wait for render
nodes.notes: httpMethod is POST on purpose. The default is GET, and a POST callback to a GET-only resume webhook 404s.

nodes.name: Render ok?
nodes.notes: A render fails as a whole if any one chunk failed. The chunks that did render keep their rows and their files, so the retry is cheap — but a partly rendered video that reported success is one that gets uploaded with a hole in it.

nodes.name: Rendered
nodes.notes: The end of F7. F8 hangs the caption, the sheet row and the Telegram message off this node — `warnings` is already here for the '2 segments outside the safe speed range' line.

parameters.text: Gửi một URL YouTube hợp lệ. Ví dụ: https://youtube.com/watch?v=...
